# Import packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(robotstxt)
library(readxl)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(viridis)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidygeocoder)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(maps)
library(usmap)
```

# Import wrangled dataset
```{r}
load("data/wrangledData.Rdata")
```

# Narrow down the columns we need for visualizing in aid and HDCOACH_salary geospatial
```{r}
aid_visual <- aid_geospatial |>
  select(institution_name, latitude, longitude, male_female_aid_ratio)

HDCOACH_salary_visual <- HDCOACH_salary_geospatial |>
  select(institution_name, latitude, longitude, male_female_salary_ratio)
```

# Create "transformed" objects for aid and salary
# Use transform instead of sf because we are using usmaps package and not maps
```{r}
# CRS is Coordinate Reference System
# Without CRS, sf will assign NA for spatial reference and can't be plot
# Use us_map transform instead of st_as_sf (part of usmap package)
aid_transformed <- aid_visual |>
  usmap_transform(input_names = c("longitude", "latitude"))

HDCOACH_transformed <- HDCOACH_salary_visual |>
  usmap_transform(input_names = c("longitude", "latitude"))
```



# Create visualization of US map and plot each institution for aid
# If greater than 1.0, men get more aid than women for that institution
# If less than 1.0, women get more aid than men for that institution
# General trend: Institutions in the West seem to have fairly even aid between men and women
# General trend: Institutions in the Southeast seem to have quite the disparity with men having more aid (Many dark circles in the south)
```{r}
# From geospatial lab (but using usmaps instead)
plot_usmap(fill = "lightgrey", color = "white") +
  geom_sf(data = aid_transformed,
          aes(color = male_female_aid_ratio),
              size = 3) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma", direction = -1,
                     labels = scales::label_number()) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(color = "",
       title = "Ratio of Male vs. Female Aid for D1 Institutions"
  )
```

# Create visualization of US map and plot each institution for Head Coach Salary
# Issue: The disparity is so high (in favor of men) that the legend started at 5x rather than 1x
# Resolution: Had to use "limits" and "scales::squish" to force the scale to start from 1x and still include every point (no NA).
```{r}
# From geospatial lab (but using usmaps instead)
plot_usmap(fill = "lightgrey", color = "white") +
  geom_sf(data = HDCOACH_transformed,
          aes(color = male_female_salary_ratio),
              size = 3) +
  scale_color_distiller(palette = "Spectral",
                        limits = c(0, 5), # Forces scale to start at 1
                        oob = scales::squish, # Groups points that are out of bounds to the nearest scaled number (i.e. 15x is not on the scale so it groups it to 5x).
                     labels = scales::label_number()) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(color = "",
       title = "Ratio of Male vs. Female Head Coach Salaries for D1 Institutions"
  )
```
